summary.text: Amy Bradstreet Arata, a Republican, represents House District 104 (Gray and New Gloucester, Cumberland County) in the Maine House of Representatives, and lives in New Gloucester. The House profile lists membership on the Appropriations and Financial Affairs Committee.

paragraphs.text: The Maine House profile lists legislative service in the House during the 129th, 130th, 131st and 132nd Legislatures.
The profile gives business owner as the occupation and lists Gordon College and the University of California, Davis, with an M.S. (1997).
It says Arata is married, to Michael, with three children.
